<SPAN USERMARK="F-11 0X000000">2) Moody's Credit Rating Definition</SPAN>
</P>

<TABLE ACLASS="NORMAL" AFIXTABLE="N" BORDER="1" WIDTH="909">

<COLGROUP>
<COL WIDTH="133"></COL>
<COL WIDTH="758"></COL>
</COLGROUP>

<TBODY>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Aaa</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Aaa are judged to be of the highest quality, with minimal credit risk.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Aa</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Aa are judged to be of high quality and are subject to very low credit risk.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">A</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">A are considered upper-medium grade and are subject to low credit risk.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Baa</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Baa are subject to moderate credit risk. </TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Ba</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Ba are judged to have speculative elements and are subject to substantial credit risk.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">B</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">B are considered speculative and are subject to high credit risk.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Caa</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Caa are judged to be of poor standing and are subject to very high credit risk.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Ca</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">Ca are highly speculative and are likely in, or very near, default, with some prospect of recovery of principal and interest.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="142" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">C</TD>
<TD WIDTH="767" HEIGHT="28" USERMARK="F-10">C are the lowest rated class and are typically in default, with little prospect for recovery of principal or interest.</TD>
</TR>

<TR ACOPY="Y" ADELETE="Y">
<TD WIDTH="909" HEIGHT="70" COLSPAN="2" USERMARK="F-10"> Moody's appends numerical modifiers 1, 2, and 3 to each generic rating classification from Aa through Caa. The modifier 1 indicates that&cr;    the obligation ranks in the higher end of its generic rating category; the modifier 2 indicates a mid-range ranking; and the modifier 3 indicates&cr;    a ranking in the lower end of that generic rating category.</TD>
</TR>
